candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Rotation/scale-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the hips bounce/lunge/spin/bow are the intentional translations. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof (the Blender attachment audit covers listed part pairs).
note: glTF axes: +Y up, character faces -Z; his right hand (mic) is +X. Root at the floor origin under the body centre. The bind pose holds the arms out in an A-pose (hence the 0.98 m rest width); the sheet pose is about 0.66 m wide (the blockout measured 0.658 m).
